|---|---|---|

- Uses **color shading** (diverging scale) across counties rather than stacking.

|---|---|---|

| Change in working-age (25 to 54 years old) population from 2007 to 2017 | Quantitative | Color/hue lightness on counties using a diverging scale (purple to orange) |
